finding: Human ploughmen are named separately from other field occupations.
model_consequence: Operator work is a qualified subset of human time, not an extra workforce.

model_consequence: One operator/one yoke can be an explicit conditional scenario; no universal observed ratio.

finding: The tree-planted comparison calls for additional workers.

finding: Four prescribed days combine first breaking, repeat passes, ridging and sowing.
model_consequence: Not four identical passes; avoid charging the same sowing/ridging again.

finding: Both drought and unsuitable wetness impede acceptable tillage.
model_consequence: Qualitative condition only; no numeric soil-moisture cutoff.

finding: Topography and soil alter timing, furrow direction and prescribed effort.
model_consequence: No universal calendar or soil-invariant task rate.

finding: Explicit schedules differ with land and operation context.
model_consequence: Preserve the differing counts; do not replace all tasks with one average.

finding: The crop list states seed volumes; the method example explicitly states a land area.

finding: The annual example allows nonplough days and other hauling duties.
